title: The Divine Reward of Intercession
english: It is as if they have even relaxed their efforts, as if to test a greater goodwill from you regarding the embassy, and a participation in the things of those who are zealous for the good things from God. For in his holy churches and in the pleasant and martyric places, as if in other heavens, his unceasing good things have been provided; and from those which this same King of kings and Lord of lords (Rev 19:16) has given and continues to give to each one even today, receiving a bloodless sacrifice offered piously and holily from these, he possesses all honors from men.

But I consider that regarding the things of the heretics and the things of theology, and the irrational animals—even the stones themselves—there is a readiness to agree with us. For what does not love for God do? Or what true charm yields to the heart? For know that it has been done, with God, that everything should be spoken, both with you and with the saints of our own nature who intercede, so that I might not yet have encountered any kind of lawsuit or bad accusation on your behalf, you who have honors according to your measure among all people; nor to call me by name into a contest or judgment concerning this, even when those who accuse are found to be speaking of things that are not; but rather that I might not be tested by being scrutinized as if I had heard words against the Word of God and the Holy Spirit, and out of shame or fear of the speaker, having yielded and having praised the unseemly things; or having at all times been negligent and having remained in a state of laziness, not being able to oppose with strength; especially to say many things from the opposite side, as if a convenient and easy day would always pass by for such things, either to receive a lawsuit or to take one.

For I consider all the toil and the danger to be a greatest and eternal profit for myself, for those from me, and for those with us, if it would be necessary to encounter a lawsuit or danger on behalf of Him who made us and saves us, and to judge and to have acted out of philanthropy for His sake, having the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Knowing, therefore, as chosen worshippers of the all-encompassing Trinity and ambassadors of the human race, that nothing else besides Him, the cause and life-giver of all, should be shown to you in terms of shame toward those who assemble with me, I owe these wise reminders and phrases to her.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
